xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5198: Flywheel page: Needs-you click only highlights the newest message; make each item actionable

plan.title: Flywheel page: Needs-you click only highlights the newest message; make each item actionable
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: On the Flywheel page, clicking the Needs you block jumps to the newest tick message, which is already on screen and never explains the items because the loop repeats them every tick. The whole line is one button, so no issue, PR or step inside it can be opened.
narratives.Proposal: The status deriver splits the newest tick's needs-you line on ";" and, from the transcript it already reads, finds each item's first-raised tick (the oldest tick of the item's current unbroken run), returned as lastTick.needsYouItems. The Status pane renders one row per item; issue IDs open the issue drawer, PR references link when their repo is known, and clicking a row jumps the conversation to the first-raised message after a pending question keeps priority. The skill tells the loop to qualify cross-repo PRs; docs and changelog describe it.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No new route, stored field, SQLite row or file write; the page stays a derived view.
- No change to NeedsYouIndicator's count or the reveal mechanism (flywheelReveal).
- No change to resolveNeedsYouAction(), useOlderHistory/MessagesTimeline jump paging, or its 100-page cap.
- No guessing of a PR's repository: a bare #<n> with no in-flight match is plain text, never a link to the flywheel project's repo.
- No change to pan flywheel status text output.
- No needs-you rows for in-flight rows with attention needs-you; they keep their table badge.
- No apps/mobile change.
- No fuzzy item matching: the issue fixes the rule (trim + lower-case); reworded items are fixed at the source by the skill item.
- An unreachable jump target (past 100 pages or before the session file) keeps today's silent no-scroll.

autoDecisions.summary: First-raised resolution runs on the server in deriveFlywheelStatus and ships as optional lastTick.needsYouItems; no new route
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks to reuse the derived status read path; the transcript is already parsed there, and an optional field keeps older fixtures and servers rendering.

autoDecisions.summary: Bare PR references (PR #n, #n) link only through an in-flight row with that PR number; owner/repo#n links to GitHub; anything else stays plain text
autoDecisions.rationale: The report's own "PR #7" is an overdeck-landing PR (verified in the flywheel transcript), so linking bare numbers to the flywheel project repo would open the wrong PR.

autoDecisions.summary: Issue IDs match \b[A-Z]{2,}-\d+\b, not only PAN-<n>
autoDecisions.rationale: The flywheel can drive other projects (MIN, KRUX); project prefixes are letters only per conventions (PAN-4860).

autoDecisions.summary: Rows are <li role="button" tabIndex=0> with Enter/Space handling; links stop propagation
autoDecisions.rationale: Links cannot nest inside a <button>; role=button rows are an existing pattern (PipelineRow.tsx).

autoDecisions.summary: Add a skill rule: separate needs-you items with "; " and write cross-repo PRs as owner/repo#<n>
autoDecisions.rationale: Makes the ; split an explicit contract and lets future cross-repo PRs link correctly.

autoDecisions.summary: A run spans tick-number resets and ends at the oldest readable tick in the current session file
autoDecisions.rationale: Only presence in consecutive tick messages defines the run; earlier session files are not read by resolveSessionFile.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the mandated exact match and add a skill rule that item wording stays identical across ticks
autoDecisions.rationale: The live-transcript probe showed the loop rewords items ("approve merging overdeck-landing PR #7" -> "PR #7 merge"), ending runs early; the issue fixes the match rule, so the cause is fixed in the skill instead.

autoDecisions.summary: The live-browser UAT check stays PRD AC-8 for the UAT role, not an xBRIEF checklist item
autoDecisions.rationale: It needs a running flywheel with a multi-tick run, which a work agent cannot reproduce in its workspace; pending .acN items would block pan done.

metadata.sizeJustification: One small vertical feature (16 files, about 300 changed lines): the contract field, the server resolver that fills it, the pane and page that read it, the skill rule that feeds it and its docs. The subsystem count comes from the repo layout (contracts, lib, tests, three frontend folders, the test-subset list, skill, docs), not from scope. Sibling issues would ship a schema field with no reader or a UI with no data, so none of them could pass UAT alone.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. Change the contracts import to a value import. In derive-status.ts replace `const lastTick = findLastTick(messages);` with newestTick + `{ ...newestTick, needsYouItems: resolveNeedsYouItems(messages) }`. Do not change actions.ts. Add the seven tick-marker cases and one derive-status case from the PRD.
